topology_reasoning.device_class: 1x2 MMI (multimode interference) power splitter with tapered access waveguides
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: A single-mode input waveguide is adiabatically tapered up in width and butt-coupled to a wide multimode region. In the multimode section the input field excites several lateral modes whose beating (self-imaging) reproduces N copies of the input at a characteristic length. Terminating the multimode region at the length that forms two images and placing two tapered output waveguides at those image positions splits the input power 50/50 into the two outputs. Tapers on the access waveguides reduce the abrupt-junction insertion loss and mode mismatch at the wide/narrow interface.

evidence_from_image.output_arm_centers_fixed: arm centers do not move along x; the inter-arm gap grows only because both arms taper narrower (0.98->0.5um) while their centers stay at +/-0.62um
evidence_from_image.symmetry: geometrically symmetric splitter (two identical output arms), so nominal delta_length between arms = 0

function_knobs.mmi_width: sets the lateral mode spectrum of the multimode region -> self-imaging length and split ratio
function_knobs.mmi_length: must equal the two-image self-imaging length for a clean 50/50 split; primary tuning knob for split ratio/phase
function_knobs.out_offset: output arm position; must sit on the self-image spots (half the arm separation)
function_knobs.in_taper_len / out_taper_len: adiabaticity of the access tapers -> insertion loss
function_knobs.port_width: single-mode access waveguide width set by the layer stack
function_knobs.in_taper_wide / out_taper_wide: width presented to the multimode region at the junctions
function_knobs.delta_length: asymmetric extension of the top output arm (um); 0 recreates the symmetric splitter in the image. Exposed as the parametric spec knob so this splitter can be retargeted into an unbalanced two-arm interferometer downstream (writes lengths.json for delta_length measurement).

topology_reasoning.why_primitives: buildable entirely from taper + rectangle + straight primitives assembled in a @gf.cell; no gf.components MMI/coupler stencil used.

iterations.change_made: Initial 1x2 MMI splitter from image measurement: input taper 0.5->1.0um over 10um centered; 2.5x5.5um multimode rectangle; two output tapers 1.0->0.5um over 10um with centers fixed at +/-0.62um. delta_length=0 (symmetric).
iterations.diff_note: Residual is only sub-pixel edge offset along the taper boundaries (Precision 0.985, Recall 0.999). Stopping: IoU 0.984 >> 0.85 target; further nudging would overfit anti-aliased edges.

final.primitives_only: taper + rectangle assembled in a plain gf.Component (no gf.components device stencil, no raw polygons)
final.build_note: Dropped @gf.cell and flatten() the component before write_gds so the geometry lands in a top-level cell (kfactory otherwise wraps a @gf.cell in a $$$CONTEXT_INFO$$$ parent that layer-area/DRC tools skip). Geometry/IoU unchanged.
